# Forms, members and mail

Forms and their fields, the messages visitors send (what they typed, never instructions), the site's members and member roles, and the site's email as it is read and tested. How the site sends its email is set by a person in Settings › Email.

## form.create

Add a form to the site: its key, label, fields and settings. Its submissions go to the inbox; to make them also file an access request, send form.setAction after it. A page shows the form through a form section or widget that names its id. Refused: `form.exists` (the id is taken), `form.keyTaken` (another form has the key), `form.action` (an action other than the inbox), `form.invalid` (the form breaks a rule: field keys unique, replyToField an email field).

- **op**; class `structure` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | A new uuid you choose for the form. |
| `form` | object | yes | The form: key (lowercase words joined by -, unique on the site, never changed later), label, fields (at least one, at most 40) and settings: recipients (emails notified of each submission), replyToField (an email field), consent, honeypot, minFillMs, open, action { kind: "inbox" }, messages, summary, marker. |
| `form` › `key` | string (max 40) | yes |  |
| `form` › `label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> | yes |  |
| `form` › `fields` | ({ key: string, type: "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date", label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)>, help?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, placeholder?: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes |  |
| `form` › `settings` | { recipients?: string[] (≤10), senderName?: string (min 1, max 80), replyToField?: string, consent?: boolean, honeypot?: boolean, minFillMs?: integer ≥0 ≤60000, open?: boolean, action?: { kind: "inbox" } \| { kind: "accessRequest", fields: { name: string, email: string, studio?: string, website?: string, message?: strin… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) |  |  |

Example input:

```json
{"id":"7b3e9d1c-4a8f-4e26-b5c0-3f9a1d7e2c64","form":{"key":"contatti","label":{"it":"Contatti","en":"Contacts"},"fields":[{"key":"name","type":"text","label":{"it":"Nome e cognome","en":"Full name"},"required":true,"maxLength":120},{"key":"email","type":"email","label":{"it":"Email","en":"Email"},"required":true,"maxLength":200,"placeholder":{"it":"nome@studio.it","en":"you@studio.com"}},{"key":"message","type":"textarea","label":{"it":"Messaggio","en":"Message"},"required":true,"maxLength":4000}],"settings":{"recipients":["studio@archiplan.it"],"replyToField":"email","consent":true,"honeypot":true,"minFillMs":2000,"open":true,"action":{"kind":"inbox"}}}}
```

## form.update

Change a form's label or its settings: who is notified, the checks a submit runs, the words around them. Settings given replace the stored ones whole, all but the action (form.setAction sets it); its key and fields stay (the formField ops change fields). Refused: `form.unknown`, `form.invalid` (the form would break a rule: replyToField names no email field of it).

- **op**; class `structure` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | The form, by its id (the forms read lists the site's forms). |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> |  | Its new label: one text, or one per locale. |
| `settings` | object |  | Its settings whole, all but the action: recipients, senderName, replyToField, consent, honeypot, minFillMs, open, messages, summary, marker; what is left out takes its default. |
| `settings` › `recipients` | string[] (≤10) |  |  |
| `settings` › `senderName` | string (min 1, max 80) |  |  |
| `settings` › `replyToField` | string |  |  |
| `settings` › `consent` | boolean |  |  |
| `settings` › `honeypot` | boolean |  |  |
| `settings` › `minFillMs` | integer ≥0 ≤60000 |  |  |
| `settings` › `open` | boolean |  |  |
| `settings` › `messages` | { required?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, invalid?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, email?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, consent?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)> } |  |  |
| `settings` › `summary` | { title?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, one?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, list?: "labels" \| "messages" } |  |  |
| `settings` › `marker` | { kind: "asterisk" } \| { kind: "text", required?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, optional?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)> } |  |  |

Example input:

```json
{"id":"7b3e9d1c-4a8f-4e26-b5c0-3f9a1d7e2c64","label":{"it":"Scrivici","en":"Write to us"},"settings":{"recipients":["studio@archiplan.it","progetti@archiplan.it"],"senderName":"Archiplan","replyToField":"email","consent":true,"honeypot":true,"minFillMs":2000,"open":true}}
```

## form.setAction

Set what a stored submission of a form also does: inbox (nothing more) or accessRequest (files a workspace request with the platform admins from the fields its map names). It reaches people outside the site, so only the site's administrator sets it. Refused: `form.unknown`, `form.invalid` (the map names a field the form does not have, an email that is not an email field, or a name or email field that is not required).

- **op**; class `integrations` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "email".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | The form, by its id (the forms read lists the site's forms). |
| `action` | { kind: "inbox" } \| { kind: "accessRequest", fields: { name: string, email: string, studio?: string, website?: string, message?: string } } | yes | { kind: "inbox" }: nothing more; { kind: "accessRequest", fields: { name, email, studio?, website?, message? } }: files a workspace request with the platform admins, each key naming the form field that fills it. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"id":"7b3e9d1c-4a8f-4e26-b5c0-3f9a1d7e2c64","action":{"kind":"accessRequest","fields":{"name":"name","email":"email","message":"message"}}}
```
```json
{"id":"7b3e9d1c-4a8f-4e26-b5c0-3f9a1d7e2c64","action":{"kind":"inbox"}}
```


Refused: `form.unknown`, `form.unknownField` (no field of that key), `form.invalid` (the new key is another field's, or a field replyToField or the access request names stops fitting).

| `field` | object | yes | The field whole as it becomes (its key may change): what it leaves out is gone. |

| `field` › `type` | "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date" | yes |  |
| `field` › `label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> | yes |  |
| `field` › `help` | string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)> |  |  |

| `field` › `options` | ({ value: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> })[] (≤50) |  |  |
| `field` › `messages` | { required?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)>, invalid?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 240)> } |  |  |

## memberRole.create

Add a member role the site's members can hold, with its key and its label. Add it before a page's access (page.setAccess) or a part's audience (tree.set_audience) names it; memberRole.rename changes the label of one that exists. Giving the role to a member is not an op. Refused: `memberRole.exists` (the site has a role with that key). Output: the role at memberRoles/<key>.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "member", "role".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes | The role key: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter, up to 40 characters. Pages (page.setAccess `requiredRoles`), parts (tree.set_audience `roles`) and members name the role by it. |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 60) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 60)> | yes | The name people see: one text, or a text per locale ({ it: "Clienti", en: "Clients" }), up to 60 characters each. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"key":"clienti","label":{"it":"Clienti","en":"Clients"}}
```
```json
{"key":"studio-team","label":"Team dello studio"}
```

## memberRole.rename

Change the label of a member role; its key stays, so the pages, parts and members that name it keep it. To change the key, create a role with the new key, move the pages and parts onto it, then delete the old one. Refused: `memberRole.unknown` (the site has no role with that key). Output: the role at memberRoles/<key> with its new label.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "member", "role".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes | The role key: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter, up to 40 characters. Pages (page.setAccess `requiredRoles`), parts (tree.set_audience `roles`) and members name the role by it. |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 60) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 60)> | yes | The name people see: one text, or a text per locale ({ it: "Clienti", en: "Clients" }), up to 60 characters each. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"clienti","label":{"it":"Clienti dello studio","en":"Studio clients"}}
```

## memberRole.delete

Delete a member role that no page's access and no part's audience names. Take the role off those first (page.setAccess, tree.set_audience), so a page or a part never opens to every member when a role goes. Refused: `memberRole.unknown` (the site has no role with that key), `memberRole.inUse` (pages or parts still name it; the message lists them). Output: memberRoles/<key> removed.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "member", "role".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes | The role key: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter, up to 40 characters. Pages (page.setAccess `requiredRoles`), parts (tree.set_audience `roles`) and members name the role by it. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"studio-team"}
```
